title: Robotics & Drones
painPoint: Robotics and drone applications demand magnets with exceptional strength-to-weight ratios and thermal stability. Servo motors in robotic arms require NdFeB grades that maintain flux density at elevated operating temperatures (80-150 degrees C). Drone propulsion motors face challenges with weight optimization, magnetic field decay at high RPMs, and demagnetization risks during rapid temperature cycling. Precision actuators need tight dimensional tolerances (plus or minus 0.05mm) and consistent magnetic properties to ensure repeatable positioning accuracy. Sourcing magnets that balance maximum energy product (BHmax) with coercivity (Hcj) remains a critical bottleneck for manufacturers scaling production.
